name: Codersly SEO
author: Codersly

sections.description:
Codersly SEO is a lightweight SEO plugin for WordPress that helps you manage titles, meta descriptions, XML sitemaps, schema markup, social sharing, redirects, and virtual robots.txt settings without the complexity of traditional all-in-one SEO suites.

It focuses on practical SEO features for everyday sites:

  • Manage <title> tags and meta descriptions
  • XML sitemaps for posts, pages, products, categories, and tags
  • Open Graph and Twitter Card meta for social previews
  • Basic schema markup for common content types
  • WooCommerce SEO support
  • Virtual robots.txt controls
  • Built-in redirect manager with 301/302 redirects
  • Social sharing with Facebook and WhatsApp
  • Built with a lightweight, modular architecture

Use Codersly SEO to configure your core SEO settings and fine-tune individual posts, pages, and products where needed.

This free plugin includes the features listed under Core features (free) below. Any advanced features mentioned in this readme are available only in the separate Codersly SEO Pro plugin.

Core features (free)

Per-post/page/product SEO meta box

  • Custom SEO Title (meta title)
  • Custom Meta Description
  • Smart fallback description generated from content when the field is empty

XML sitemaps

  • Automatic sitemaps for posts, pages, products, categories, and tags
  • Simple on/off control for specific post types and taxonomies (via settings)
  • Sitemap index compatible with search engines

Schema markup

  • Organization or Person schema (site-wide)
  • WebSite + SearchAction schema for site search
  • Article schema for posts
  • Product schema for WooCommerce products

Open Graph & Twitter Cards

  • Global default Open Graph and Twitter meta for home and archives
  • Per-post automatic Open Graph and Twitter title/description from SEO fields

WooCommerce basic SEO

  • SEO meta support for WooCommerce products
  • Product schema for better search understanding
  • Inclusion of products in XML sitemaps

Virtual robots.txt manager

  • Enable or disable plugin-generated virtual robots.txt output
  • Add custom robots.txt rules from the settings page
  • Automatically append the sitemap URL when XML sitemaps are enabled

Redirect manager

  • 301/302 redirects in the free plugin
  • Simple redirect table with add, filter, and delete actions

Breadcrumbs

  • Simple breadcrumbs function and shortcode
  • Includes structured data for BreadcrumbList

Social sharing

  • Facebook share button
  • WhatsApp share button

Basic image SEO helper

  • Optional helper to generate simple alt attributes when missing

Additional features available separately in Codersly SEO Pro

Codersly SEO Pro extends the free plugin with additional advanced tools, including features such as:

  • AI content tools
  • Site audit and advanced reports
  • Content analysis
  • Advanced schema options
  • 404 monitor
  • Local SEO tools
  • Advanced image SEO tools
  • Internal link suggestions
  • Search Console integration
  • Advanced WooCommerce SEO fields

External services

This plugin includes links to external services and optional social sharing endpoints.

  1. Codersly website / Codersly SEO Pro
    Used to let site administrators learn about the separately available Pro add-on from the plugin settings screens.
    Data sent: No personal site data is automatically transmitted by the plugin just to display these admin screens. If an administrator clicks a Pro link, their browser connects directly to codersly.com.
    Terms of Service: https://codersly.com/terms-conditions/
    Privacy Policy: https://codersly.com/privacy-policy/

  2. Facebook share endpoint
    Used only when a visitor clicks the Facebook share button generated by the plugin.
    Data sent: The current page URL is sent to Facebook only after the visitor clicks the share button.
    Terms of Service: https://www.facebook.com/legal/terms
    Privacy Policy: https://www.facebook.com/privacy/policy/

  3. WhatsApp share endpoint
    Used only when a visitor clicks the WhatsApp share button generated by the plugin.
    Data sent: The current page title and URL are sent to WhatsApp only after the visitor clicks the share button.
    Terms of Service: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/terms-of-service
    Privacy Policy: https://www.whatsapp.com/legal/privacy-policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the codersly-seo folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress Plugins → Add New screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Codersly SEO to configure global SEO settings such as titles, sitemaps, schema, robots.txt, redirects, and social sharing.
  4. Edit any post, page, or product and look for the Codersly SEO meta box to set a custom SEO title and meta description.
  5. Additional advanced features are available separately in Codersly SEO Pro.
sections.faq:
Does Codersly SEO work with any theme?

Yes. Codersly SEO is designed to work with properly coded WordPress themes.

Does it support WooCommerce?

Yes. The plugin includes WooCommerce SEO support, product schema, and sitemap entries for WooCommerce products.

Does the free plugin include social sharing?

Yes. The free plugin includes Facebook and WhatsApp social sharing buttons.

Does the free plugin include robots.txt settings?

Yes. The free plugin includes virtual robots.txt controls, including custom rules and sitemap URL output.

Does the free plugin include redirects?

Yes. The free plugin includes a redirect manager with 301/302 redirects.

What about meta keywords?

Codersly SEO does not implement meta keywords because major search engines no longer use them for ranking.

Does the free plugin include all of its listed core features?

Yes. The free plugin includes the features listed in the Core features (free) section of this readme. Additional advanced features are available separately in Codersly SEO Pro.

Can I use Codersly SEO alongside other SEO plugins?

Running multiple SEO plugins at the same time is not recommended, because they may all try to output titles, meta descriptions, Open Graph tags, schema, and sitemaps. For best results, use only one SEO plugin at a time.
sections.changelog:
1.0.8

  • Added tag archive noindex and search result noindex controls for thin-content SEO cleanup.
  • Updated Pro placeholder menu labels: AI Content Pro, AI Audit Pro, 404 Pro, Schema Pro, and Upgrade.
  • Kept Redirects as a free feature.
  • Added clearer AI Content and AI Audit Pro placeholder tabs for the managed Codersly AI API workflow.
  • Added Cloud Publisher tab mapping support for the Pro add-on.
  • Improved admin tab stability when Pro menus are active.

1.0.7

  • Updated: renamed “Site Audit” menu and tab placeholders to “AI Audit” to better reflect the AI‑powered audit functionality available in the Pro plugin. This ensures users clearly see that the audit feature is AI‑driven and part of the Pro offering.

1.0.6

  • Initial public release on WordPress.org.
